supersedes_nothing: runtime-benchmark-plan-r01.json remains the retained completed-idle/steady-state declaration and is not an active-work result.

process_memory_observation.interpretation: The operating-system peak working set is distinct from the maximum sampled working/private bytes. Real gaps and incomplete observations are retained; sampled private bytes are not an instantaneous proven peak.

comparison_rules.counterbalancing: Within every scored pair, odd blocks run published then candidate and even blocks candidate then published. Warm-ups are unscored and retained separately.

candidate_time_per_tick_limit.rule: candidate median <= published median + max(10 percent of published median, 0.25 ms/tick)

candidate_memory_limits.rule: candidate median <= published median + max(10 percent of published median, 64 MiB), evaluated separately for each metric

agriculture_within_arm_increment_128_min.rule: Report candidate and published 128-minus-1 raw differences separately. A percentage comparison is permitted only when the matching published incremental denominator is finite and strictly positive; otherwise report raw differences only, with no percentage or inferred non-regression conclusion from noise.

repair_active.physical_work: First post-load tick damages exactly 1000 walls; 256 eligible player/reciprocal-friendly walls await native passive repair, while 744 overflow walls, foreign walls and a non-wall remain unchanged.

agriculture_active.physical_work: Two real lab completions and N towers per player/zero-research foreign force are prepared before saving. The first post-load tick performs one native seed insertion per tower and requires exactly 2N on_tower_planted_seed events.

preparation_outside_scored_timing: Native active-seed preparation, not generic CreateOnly: the selected repair or agriculture fixture must reach one unique prepared marker and write a closed mir5-native-active save before the benchmark loads it. Agriculture preparation includes its two real lab completions; repair preparation stops before its first post-load physical damage.
The prepared-save receipt must bind the exact selected profile, fixture archives, player archive, active-save hash and marker raw log. It is a seed-preparation observation, not a timing result.

An unscored post-load marker pilot must retain one unique start and one unique complete active marker for the selected arm/tier before any scored benchmark sample. The pilot is not a performance acceptance sample.

Fresh private controller binding to this plan, its raw helper bytes, the active-save receipts and the current direct libraries is required before scored timing. A source/profile staging read may occur before active saves exist, but must refuse timing without them.
